ExecutionPacket.purpose: Publish one accepted ARMY-97 card with synchronized projections.
ExecutionPacket.write-scope: tasks/task-XXXX/README.md, collections, graph, verification, and Beads
ExecutionPacket.stop-conditions: Stop on incomplete starter, provenance, membership drift, or failed local gate.

FailurePacket.suggested-next-action: Repair the first divergence and rerun the full gate.

Army97CandidateRecord.centralAction: One independently worded observable task action.
Army97CandidateRecord.starterBehavior: Local behavior presented to the student before changes.
Army97CandidateRecord.expectedResult: Observable result after the task is complete.
Army97CandidateRecord.sourceAuditDecision: accepted | needs-rewrite | rejected | duplicate; immutable after the revision closes.
Army97CandidateRecord.decisionEvidence: Completeness, contradiction, or exact three-axis duplicate evidence; immutable.
Army97CandidateRecord.duplicateTarget: Earliest equal candidate ID or none; immutable.
Army97CandidateRecord.correctionPath: Required source repair for needs-rewrite or none; immutable audit evidence.
Army97CandidateRecord.publicationDecision: accepted | needs-rewrite; mutable only through the publication gate.
Army97CandidateRecord.publicationTransitionEvidence: Source-freeze marker or CardMigrationEvidence PASS plus full local gate evidence.
Army97CandidateRecord.targetTaskId: Contiguous task-XXXX for every distinct record, or none only for a duplicate.
Army97CandidateRecord.targetCollection: Exactly one controlled thematic collection path.

Army97PublicationDecisionTransition.requiredEvidence: publicationTransitionEvidence names CardMigrationEvidence with verdict PASS and the full local gate.
Army97PublicationDecisionTransition.immutableFields: sourceAuditRevision, sourceAuditDecision, decisionEvidence, duplicateTarget, correctionPath, targetTaskId, targetCollection
Army97PublicationDecisionTransition.countRule: Derive current publicationDecision counts; never compare them with source-audit snapshot counts.

Army97CardWorkItem.targetCollection: Exactly one controlled thematic collection path.
Army97CardWorkItem.expectedLocalMarkdownEvidence: Complete card, synchronized projection and GRACE evidence, and full local gate PASS.
Army97CardWorkItem.publicationDecision: Mutable publication value synchronized with the candidate.
Army97CardWorkItem.publicationTransitionEvidence: Source-freeze marker or CardMigrationEvidence PASS evidence.

CardMigrationEvidence.editorProfile: Programiz | CodePen | TypeScript Playground | React TypeScript
CardMigrationEvidence.destinationLocations: Card, collections, graph, verification, and Beads locations.
CardMigrationEvidence.verdict: PASS | FAIL from local deterministic checks.

Army97WaveReport.task-ids: 8-10 immutable task IDs, or final incomplete wave.
Army97WaveReport.commands: Full local gate, xmllint, Grace, and diff check.

Army97FailureHandoff.first-divergence: First card, collection, simulation, graph, verification, or Beads fact.
Army97FailureHandoff.next-action: Repair the first divergence and rerun the complete local gate.
